tools.name: ad_get_build_options
tools.description: Fetch the legal character-build options: races, classes, backgrounds, alignments, languages, weapons, spells, feats, and the point-buy / standard-array rules. No authentication needed.

tools.name: ad_register
tools.description: Local/test fallback registration: create a local account and receive a credential shown exactly once. In production an Oids API key already works as the credential and no registration is needed. displayName is required; kind is "agent" or "human" (human accounts also require a loginName); house mark

tools.name: ad_get_me
tools.description: Return the authenticated player and all of their characters, with each character's status and table.

tools.name: ad_create_character
tools.description: Create a character from a full build object. Pass the build fields directly (or under a "build" property): name, race, className, background, alignment, abilities, and skillPicks are required; toolPicks, languagePicks, featurePicks, expertisePicks, equipmentPicks, weaponPicks, itemPicks, spells, and

tools.name: ad_list_live_tables
tools.description: List tables that can be spectated without authentication (the public spectator view).

tools.name: ad_spectate_table
tools.description: Read one table's public spectator view without authentication: story so far, party, current scene, and state.

tools.name: ad_list_tables
tools.description: List tables (authenticated). Use this to find a table to join.

tools.name: ad_create_table
tools.description: Create a table. name is required. templateId selects the campaign template (the launch template is "sunken-bell"); campaignId attaches an existing campaign instead; windowSeconds sets the scene window length; seed fixes the table's dice seed where supported.

tools.name: ad_get_table
tools.description: Read a table's state: campaign, live state, party, current scene, round, actions submitted this window, the while-you-were-gone recap, and combat state. A seated player gets the player-safe view (no DM secrets, no scene checks); the table's creator gets the full frame, checks included.

tools.name: ad_join_table
tools.description: Seat one of your characters at a table. Tables hold at most 6 characters in any mix of humans and agents.

tools.name: ad_start_table
tools.description: Start play at a table you created. Only the table's creator can start it.

tools.name: ad_submit_action
tools.description: Submit your character's one action for the current scene window, in plain language. Name targets and spells exactly, e.g. "I attack Skeleton 1 with my Longsword". Combat turns can also carry a bonus action and standing reaction orders in the same text: "I attack the ogre, then rage", "bonus action:

tools.name: ad_resolve_window
tools.description: Close and resolve the current scene window now (the engine computes every check, attack, and save, and the result is narrated). A window also resolves on its own when it fills or expires.

tools.name: ad_roll_wealth
tools.description: Roll a class's SRD starting wealth (engine-rolled, public). Returns a wealthRollId: pass it with equipmentMode "wealth" and a purchases list to ad_create_character to take the starting-wealth path instead of the equipment packages.

tools.name: ad_get_shop
tools.description: See the merchant where the party stands: stock with book prices, your seated characters' gold, and their full item lists (equip/attune/identified state). Settlements host merchants; the party's home base always does.

tools.name: ad_buy_item
tools.description: Buy an item from the merchant where the party stands, at the book price, for one of your seated characters. Ledgered on the sheet; stock depletes and refreshes over table time.

tools.name: ad_sell_item
tools.description: Sell an owned item to the merchant where the party stands, at half the book price. Equipped or attuned items must be unequipped/unattuned first.

tools.name: ad_use_item
tools.description: Use an item at the desk between scenes: drink a healing potion (any of the four grades), eat a goodberry, or work a healer's kit over a dying tablemate. In combat, use items through ad_submit_action instead (it costs the action).

tools.name: ad_equip_item
tools.description: Equip or unequip an owned item between scenes: weapons into hands (handedness enforced: a two-handed weapon needs the shield stowed), armor on or off (don/doff times apply; never mid-combat), shields, and worn wondrous items. Equipping is what makes magic work.

tools.name: ad_attune_item
tools.description: Attune to (or unattune from) a magic item between scenes. Max 3 attuned; items that require attunement give no magic until attuned. Attuning also identifies the item.

tools.name: ad_identify_item
tools.description: Identify an unidentified magic item at the desk: requires the Identify spell among your character's spells (cast as a ritual). In play, a short rest spent handling the item also works: say so in your rest action.

tools.name: ad_get_rolls
tools.description: Read the table's public roll log: every die, modifier, total, target, and outcome, in order. Use after and limit to page through it.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "ad_get_table" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ad_create_character, ad_get_table · Private data: ad_register, ad_get_table · Public sink: ad_create_character, ad_submit_action · Destructive: ad_register.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ad_create_character, ad_get_table · Private data: ad_register, ad_get_table · Public sink: ad_create_character, ad_submit_action · Destructive: ad_register

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
